W07

Personal/global academic calendar

/app/calendar
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S12

Combine published course dates, private appointments and scoped staff grading deadlines in one planner. A TA marking deadline stays distinct from the student submission deadline.

Permissions
  • Private events never enter course calendars, staff views, rosters or exports by default.
  • TA deadlines originate from W57 allocations; TAs cannot change policy, release or other TAs' tasks.
  • Academic dates are read-only here.
Responsive
  • Agenda is the default narrow view; week grid has equivalent list.
  • Drawer becomes full-width; no drag-only editing.
Accessibility
  • Provide keyboard date navigation and a non-grid agenda.
  • Announce save outcome; avoid announcing every minute of a countdown.
Data
  • Shared academic event ID/version, source timestamp, timezone and personal allowance.
  • Private owner-only recurrence and exception records; allocated staff task references.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A private work shift never appears when instructor views W32.
  • Editing one recurrence leaves all other occurrences unchanged.
  • Changed exam time retires the old reminder and appears once in combined/course views.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • Proposed planner limits are original product choices; no Google Calendar parity or live delivery is promised.
